verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no absolute tensor throughput figure (TFLOPS or TOPS) for the RTX 5090, and no precision-by-precision or dense-vs-sparse breakdown. The closest item, docs-22, lists the supported precisions (FP4, FP6, FP8, FP16, BF16, TF32) but gives only a relative 'up to 3x higher throughput' claim, which is exactly the bare marketing number the story rejects. Community items cover memory bandwidth and relative benchmark speedups, not published tensor throughput an engineer could size workloads from.
